notes: Dashboard 2.0 (@flowfuse/node-red-dashboard, /dashboard) migration: ui-page /wp-update, ui-groups and widgets converted (ui-toast -> ui-notification; 60 s download notifications via msg.ui_update.displayTime). The file does NOT ship a ui-base/ui-theme (importing several Dashboard 2.0 tab files would put two ui-base nodes on /dashboard, which breaks widget wiring): assign the page + notification nodes to your single ui-base in the editor sidebar. Requires @flowfuse/node-red-dashboard installed. Logic unchanged from v4.12.11 except the two toast messages.
